M2.reason: Measured size is 25.8 x 18.7 x 13.1 against the original's 25.9 x 19.2 x 13.2. The largest difference is 2.6% (height), so all three dimensions are within 10%.

The reproduction's mouth is smaller, framed by brown shell, and the red flesh around it is reduced. The back shell's crest is also simpler than the original's.

M7.reason: The front faces the same way as the original in the Front view (mouth and eye marks on the front). It is upright, and the feet touch the ground at the same points in the Left and Right views.

M8.reason: The SMAK checks report no errors, and at 364 triangles against the original's 478 it is well under the twice-the-original cap. However, the light dashed lines along seams in the Left, Front-left and Front views look like small gaps where the background shows through.
